title: Transport a linearity criterion across a ring-sheaf isomorphism
statement: Let $U,V$ be schemes and $f:U\to V$ a morphism on their small etale sites [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. Let $R_V,R_U$ be commutative ring sheaves, $L_r$ a left adjoint to the ring direct image with adjunction $a_r$, $c:L_r(R_V)\cong R_U$, and $\gamma:R_V\to f_*R_U$ the adjunct of $c$. Write $F_V,F_0,F_U$ for forgetting modules over $R_V,L_r(R_V),R_U$ to abelian sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and $a:L_a\dashv R_a$ for the etale abelian adjunction. Suppose $L_0:\operatorname{Mod}(R_V)\to\operatorname{Mod}(L_r(R_V))$ and $e_0:L_0F_0\cong F_VL_a$ are given. Assume that for every $G,F$ and abelian map $\alpha:L_aF_VG\to F_0F$, a linear lift $h:L_0G\to F$ with $F_0h=e_0(G)\alpha$ exists iff the abelian adjunct of $\alpha$ lifts to an $R_V$-linear map $G\to R_0F$, where $R_0$ is direct image along $a_r$'s ring unit [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. Then there exist $L_M:\operatorname{Mod}(R_V)\to\operatorname{Mod}(R_U)$, $e:L_MF_U\cong F_VL_a$, $t:L_M\operatorname{res}_c\cong L_0$, and $a_M:L_M\dashv f_{*,\gamma}$. For every $G$, $F_0(t_G)e_{0,G}=e_G$. For every linear $h:L_MG\to F$, $F_V(a_M(h))=a(e_G^{-1}F_Uh)$.

proof.text: Use hlin in both directions to construct a hom equivalence between L0(G) -> F and G -> R0(F), where R0 is module pushforward along the ring unit. Faithfulness of the two toSheaf functors proves that the chosen lifts are unique, and that the two assignments are inverse. Naturality follows by applying those faithful functors and using naturality of e0 and of the abelian hom equivalence. Adjunction.mkOfHomEquiv gives a0 and its underlying hom formula.

Set P and Q to module pushforward on the identity site functor along c.inv and c.hom. Mathlib SheafOfModules.pushforwardComp, pushforwardCongr, and pushforwardId give the unit and counit isomorphisms from the inverse-ring identities. Their section maps are identities, so the triangle identity follows sectionwise. Define LM = L0 followed by P, t from the unit inverse, and e from the identity-on-abelian-sheaves comparison followed by e0. The comparison equation follows sectionwise by reflexivity.

The adjunct equation hc and Adjunction.homEquiv_unit identify gamma with the ring unit followed by ring pushforward of c.hom. Use pushforwardComp and pushforwardCongr to identify Q followed by R0 with module pushforward along gamma. Compose a0 with the scalar equivalence adjunction and transport the right functor through this comparison. Expand homEquiv_ofNatIsoRight_apply and comp_homEquiv; the right comparison acts as the identity on underlying sections. The a0 hom formula then reduces the final equality to the identity-on-sections scalar equivalence unit, discharged by definitional equality.
